source: WHO Basic Emergency Care / IFRC First Aid Guidelines

translations.en: Perform triage: sort casualties by severity. Priority: breathing problems, severe bleeding, shock. Move life-threatening cases first.
translations.bi: Mekem triage: sotem olgeta man blong sik wetem severity. Fastaem: problem blong bret, blad we hemi no stop, sok. Muv olgeta keis we oli denjeres fastaem.
translations.tpi: Mekim triage: sotim olgeta man long sik olsem severity. Pastaim: hevi win, bikpela blut, sok. Muv ol keis i denja pastaim.
translations.ht: Fè triage: triye viktim yo pa gravite. Priyorite: pwoblèm respirasyon, senyen sevè, chòk. Deplase ka ki mete lavi an danje yo an premye.

translations.en: Apply direct pressure to severe bleeding wounds. Do not remove pressure. Elevate limb if no fracture suspected.
translations.bi: Pressing strong long wound we hemi blad hard. No tekemaot handes. Levetem arm oa leg sapos no gat fraksa.
translations.tpi: Presim strong long wound i blut hard. No rausim han. Lifim han o leg sapos yu ting no gat breakbone.
translations.ht: Aplike presyon dirèk sou blesi ki senyen grav. Pa retire presyon an. Eleve manm si pa gen frakti sipoze.

translations.en: If victim is unresponsive and not breathing normally, begin CPR if trained. Call for trained medical personnel immediately.
translations.bi: Sapos victim hemi no respond mo hemi no bret olsem normal, statem CPR sapos yu trained. Singaot long trained medical staff naoia.
translations.tpi: Sapos victim i no tok na i no win rait, kirapim CPR sapos yu trained. Singaut long ol dokta trained nau.
translations.ht: Si viktim pa reponn epi pa respire nòmalman, kòmanse CPR si ou fòme pou sa. Rele pèsonèl medikal fòme imedyatman.

translations.en: Immobilize suspected fractures using available materials. Do not attempt to straighten deformed limbs.
translations.bi: Faesem eni saspekted fraksa wetem ol material we oli save. No traem blong stretem leg oa arm we hemi bented.
translations.tpi: Pasim eni fraksa ol man i ting long ol samting i stap. No traim stretim leg o han i bin.
translations.ht: Inobilize frakti sipoze yo ak materyèl ki disponib. Pa eseye redrese manm defòme yo.

translations.en: Document number of casualties by severity level. Request medical evacuation transport for critical cases.
translations.bi: Raetedown namba blong ol man we oli hurt wetem severity level. Askem transport blong medevac long ol keis we oli kritikol.
translations.tpi: Raitim namba bilong olgeta man long ol leta bilong sik. Askim medevac transport long ol keis i hevi.
translations.ht: Dokimante kantite viktim pa nivo gravite. Mande transpò evakiyasyon medikal pou ka kritik yo.
